title: SF169 (2025-2026 Regular): Veteran discharge papers legal equivalent of a permit to carry a firearm establishment

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2025-01-15; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2025/0/SF/169/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version as filed, 2025-01-15; no vote recorded.

operative_text: Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 25): Notwithstanding any provision in this section or other law to the contrary, a veteran, as defined in section 197.447, may carry a pistol as provided in this subdivision under any circumstances and in any location in which a permit to carry is otherwise required. The veteran must possess the original or a certified copy of the veteran's government form DD214 while carrying the pistol. This form constitutes the legal equivalency of a permit to carry. The veteran is not required to apply for a permit to carry, pay any fees, or demonstrate training in the safe use of a pistol. All other provisions of this section and other laws relating to permits to carry pistols apply to a veteran carrying under this subdivision.
